source: HYCOM + NCODA Global 1/12 deg Analysis (GLBy0.08, expt_93.0)
provider: HYCOM Consortium / US Naval Research Laboratory, served via THREDDS
why_this_source: INCOIS ERDDAP carries no usable ocean-current field. Its only current variables, GEO_U/GEO_V in incois_valueadded_products_datasets, are a raw geostrophic diagnostic applied across the equator where the Coriolis parameter approaches zero, giving ~15% non-physical cells at every date tested over the full 2004-2019 record. HYCOM is a dynamical model, so it has no geostrophic singularity.
cf_compliance: CF standard_name and units present on every variable; values packed as Int16 with scale_factor, decoded by xarray decode_cf
note: Chlorophyll (DIR-002) is not in HYCOM. RESOLVED: supplied by BGC-Argo at data/raw/obs/argo_bgc_synthetic/. INCOIS IRS_chlorophyll_datasets was evaluated and rejected - surface-only 2D with no depth axis, and coverage ends 2006-03-21.
